summary: Adds its GameObject to a runtime set while enabled, and removes it when disabled.
overview: The other half of a runtime set. Drop it on anything that should count itself — an enemy, a pickup, any spawned instance you want a live list of.
useCases: Making every spawned enemy countable without the spawner tracking them.
Keeping a pooled object out of the set while it sits in the pool.

params.tuning: Unassigned, the object simply never registers — silently, which is the usual reason a set looks empty.

gotchas.title: Pooled objects rely on this being enable-driven
gotchas.body: Because it registers in OnEnable and unregisters in OnDisable, a pooled object correctly leaves the set when returned. Registering in Awake instead would leave dead entries in it.
